On occasion, the Clerk and Master is appointed by the Chancellor to auction properties. The property is sold to the highest bidder who is required to remit 10% of the purchase price to the Clerk and Master's Office on the day of the sale with the remaining balance due within 30 days as long as there are no raised bids or objections. Any raised bid after the sale must be 10% more than the highest bid. If the bid is raised, the Clerk and Master will schedule another auction date and begin the bidding at the raised bid price.

You may register to bid on the properties through www.zeusauction.com. Instructions for registration are available on their website.
